type Intersect<A, B, C> = A & B & C;
const one: Intersect<boolean, any, null> = 1;
const two: Intersect<any, boolean, null> = 2;
const three: Intersect<boolean, null, any> = 3;
const four: boolean & any & null = 4;
const five: (true | false) & any & null = 5;
const six: Intersect<false | true, any, null> & any = 6;
const seven: Intersect<null, any, null> = 7;
const eight: Intersect<boolean, any, true> = 8;
const nine: Intersect<boolean, any, false> = 9;
console.log(one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine);
